reviews.text: Excellent care provided by a very attentive team for the well-being of my animals for the past 26 years

Medications marked up at 300% but expired for two years, insensitive to animals, and payment by credit card is not accepted.

Mr. Elbaz only cares about money; avoid him.

Absolutely avoid this place.

Abnormally high prices, austere premises, and above all, no credit card payment terminal… in 2026. This isn't even mentioned at the entrance, which is illegal. They require a bank transfer with an email address to which they can send proof of payment, instead of simply investing €200 in a card reader.
It's astounding to see this in a medical facility, and one can easily suspect that the goal is also to encourage cash payments.

Much better establishments exist in the area.

Highly competent and specialized veterinarians, deeply concerned with animal welfare and pain management. Drs. Elbaz and Dubreuil kept our Westie, Rosie, in excellent health for 18 years despite eight major surgeries and two strokes. Three days before her death, Rosie was still chasing squirrels. I recommend these veterinarians whenever I can. They are currently caring for Penelope, our little poodle. I also commend the entire team for their kindness and expertise.
A very kind and gentle doctor. A true educator and passionate about his profession. An animal lover, efficient and competent.
Excellent clinic, both vets are great. Even though I've moved, I'll continue to go to this clinic!

Worst experience of my life! If I could have given zero stars, I would have without hesitation…

My cat fractured her pelvis. I took her there as an emergency; so far, so good. Then they kept her for 24 hours. I had to call several times for updates, and when I finally got through to the vet, he sighed every time I asked a question, never offering any reassurance, just repeating, "Well, I'll repeat myself since you still don't understand," as if I were an idiot.

Then came a bill for €700; no problem, I paid. Except, to my great surprise, there was no treatment, just a pill. I called them back the next day, explaining that she was in pain, that she wasn't eating or drinking. They told me that was normal. So, I waited another 24 hours, and then when I called, they brushed me off. They told me they didn't want my cat because he wasn't particularly friendly. The woman on the phone, a secretary whose appearance matched her attitude, told me, "When I'm not hungry or thirsty, I don't drink. You can just bring him back; we'll keep him a little longer to see what's wrong with him" (mainly to take my money again).

Anyway, I left, with a knot in my stomach, for an amazing clinic that took him in, rehydrated him, and gave him fantastic treatment.

I also saw a situation where someone came in with their cat and said it was vomiting after a blood test. The same woman told them, "Give him to me." She came back a minute later and said, "It'll be fine, we saw him, there's nothing wrong with him, it's normal." The person didn't understand and left.

I think the reviews on this page are either fake, or they're suppressing the bad ones, because I've seen two or three abnormal situations there, and I don't see how you can let such incompetent, bad, and inhumane people do this job in a so-called center in the heart of Batignolles.

I hope you get shut down, and worse if necessary, because you're only there to take your money.

Oh yes, and the best part: they don't accept credit cards! That's the best one yet.

In short: RUN AWAY!

The best clinic. The doctors are true professionals. You don't feel like they're trying to make money off you.
Thank you 🙏 …

One star, because I can't give less…
I took my cat in because she was vomiting a lot.
The vet said it was just gastroenteritis, treated her, but she continued to vomit. So I took her back a second time, and they assured me it was indeed gastroenteritis.
Finally, since my cat's condition hadn't improved, I consulted another vet, who discovered a gum infection that had apparently been there for a long time. He also found a tumor. In the end, over €400 spent on a misdiagnosis…
Extremely disappointing experience. I do not recommend it.
Avoid at all costs!!!!
5-star welcome and care

The entire clinic team provided invaluable guidance and support throughout the entire process of caring for my 16-year-old Persian cat, Dina, right up to the difficult decision to say goodbye.

It was incredibly challenging, but Dr. Domingues and the whole team were exceptionally professional and compassionate during this heartbreaking decision.
To pet owners who want their beloved companions to be welcomed and cared for until the very end, you've come to the right place.
Thank you so much 🕊️
Professional

A huge thank you to the entire clinic team, and especially to Dr. Elbaz, who saved my little Happy countless times by wiping away my worried tears. This allowed my little mascot to live and survive until the very end of his long life. You can trust them completely; they are all dedicated professionals committed to the care of our beloved animals. Thank you again for your dedication.
Many thanks to the clinic that helped us prepare our cat for transport abroad. Their support was always fantastic and helped us manage the transport as smoothly as possible. I highly recommend them!
Delighted with the welcome and care; everything was excellent, and in case of emergency, there was always a place available. Well done to all the vets, I'm thrilled!

A team of veterinarians and veterinary assistants, attentive to our anxieties about our four-legged babies, with remarkable competence and efficiency, whose merits I can only praise and highly recommend.

Thank you again for everything you do and have done for my cats for so long.

With best regards, Alain Jacob

My rabbit died at this clinic. She was young, healthy, and was due to be spayed. When I brought her in that morning, she wasn't examined. The vet didn't even bother to speak to me. She was just left somewhere in her little carrier, surrounded by anxious, barking dogs. I can only imagine her fear and stress. Then, I was given the runaround all day when I called to say the operation was underway, only to be told at 5 PM that she had died. I haven't slept since; I feel so guilty for choosing this clinic. I'm telling the vet that the rabbit wasn't underweight, but overweight.
An excellent clinic. Friendly and highly competent staff.

The veterinarians are very kind and caring, however, I left today disappointed with their care.

I went to this clinic several times for my dog's recurring lameness. Each time, I was told it was just a sprain, related to his activity between the city and the countryside. I meticulously followed their recommendations, especially regarding warming up before long walks, but despite this, the lameness kept recurring. It wasn't for lack of trying, though, that I went back several times to report that the problem persisted.

A year ago, following more in-depth examinations elsewhere, we discovered that my dog ​​was actually suffering from a bone malformation that had not been diagnosed or treated in time. Today, we unfortunately find ourselves with a 10-year-old dog whose joint is severely affected by osteoarthritis, despite various attempts at treatment.

I want to emphasize that the team has always been kind and attentive, but I am deeply saddened to see my dog ​​suffering, knowing that the problem had been present for a long time and could have been identified and treated earlier if it had been taken seriously.

I am sharing my experience not out of resentment, but to advise pet owners not to hesitate to seek a second opinion if they feel something deeper is wrong. Despite his age, my dog ​​is in excellent overall health, and his current difficulties are solely the result of insufficient care.

This is an exceptional veterinary clinic. We've had three dogs and now a fourth. The vet has always taken excellent care of them and taken the time to explain their health problems to us. He was able to extend their lives as long as possible. I highly recommend this clinic.

Hello,

Thank you for saving Yanka the dog.
Thank you so much for Yanka, I'm so glad he's doing so well 👏👏 …
It's so wonderful to see someone so dedicated. You are a true example of passion and kindness; thank you for what you do for animals.
Thank you for taking such gentle and professional care of Yanka; you are truly a wonderful veterinarian.
It's a shame we can't give more. Thank you for continuing to work for the love of animals and not for the love of numbers like so many others!! I highly recommend it 💪🏼 …
A TikTok video shows you're an amazing vet, thank you for saving her. Thank you for Yanka.

A serious and professional human veterinarian!
Yanka
Thank you doctor for Yanka. You are a wonderful vet. Thank you for saving her ❤️
I highly recommend this veterinarian; he is very humane and professional.
Perfect

Exceptional veterinary clinic... love for animals above all else... thank you for saving Yanka 🥺🫶🏼!! I recommend them 100% without hesitation... thank you for your professionalism! 🫶🏼 …
Super vet
Thank you so much for saving Yanka the dog, thank you so much for her. Poor dog who suffered so much, you saved her, thank you so much, top-notch vet, all of TikTok is with you!
An exceptional veterinarian who truly cares about animals and even takes time off work from his days off to come and check that they are well.
An excellent veterinarian who pays attention to detail that others apparently don't. Thank you!

This vet is a true animal lover! After a disastrous TikTok video from one of his colleagues, he took in Yanka, a little dog suffering after a botched spaying procedure. On a day off, he came to his clinic just to check on the little dog. A truly excellent vet, 1000% recommended. Congratulations on your dedication to our animals!

Professional clinic with competent veterinarians.
Sometimes there's a bit of a wait.

From the initial welcome to the follow-up, the advice, the support during difficult times: the consistency of this establishment is too rare not to be highlighted.

Thank you to the entire team.
Martine and Ludo

A huge thank you to the entire veterinary team for their warm welcome, excellent care, and above all, their wonderful kindness and compassion.

Special mention to Dr. Gamucci, who is exceptionally compassionate, and to Dr. Domingues, who took such good care of Dao! ❤️
Excellent clinic! The nurses and doctors treat the animals (in my case, it was a rabbit) with great care and gentleness. Very kind and professional people. The best clinic! I highly recommend it.

A team of pleasant and competent caregivers.

But no card payment terminal in 2025... that's more than annoying and, above all, very suspicious. Bank fees are more than affordable these days for these services, so one wonders: are the owners simply incredibly stingy? Or is operating under the table and only declaring a portion of their revenue a passion?

A huge thank you to Dr. Elbaz who, through his intervention on my cat Romeo's tear ducts, resolved his conjunctivitis problems. Since February, he has had no more ear problems. I highly recommend this clinic for the competence and kindness of the veterinarians and assistants. S. Ferhat

To respond to the owner (who doesn't want to argue), following my message:
I'm fully aware that treating a 50g bird isn't easy. I'm fully aware that knowing all the animals is a challenge. But at least acknowledging it would be honorable, instead of accusing us of not knowing how to administer an antibiotic orally (when it must be injected) and of not knowing how to apply an ointment! You imply in your message that our sole purpose is purely commercial. No! We wanted to treat our bird. But when you sell us an antibiotic that must be injected and not ingested, and you sell us an ointment for pigs, goats, and dogs after finding that the expired product you gave us had no effect, and when, of course, you don't control the price of medications, but you mark them up, and all of this in cash only, I can also ask myself the same question. Finally, just in case you forgot, we paid for both consultations. Only my phone call wasn't billed. Phew!

A very bad experience with a bird (lovebird). It would have been better to refer us to a veterinarian who knew how to treat these animals. We purchased (expensive) medication at the clinic, but it didn't work. He even gave us medication that had expired almost three years ago! His condition worsened. He was listless. Two consultations (and other equally expensive medications) didn't change anything. After two weeks, we consulted another veterinarian who made the correct diagnosis, prescribed the appropriate medication, and within eight days, our bird was back in shape. We contacted the veterinarian, who, of course, blamed it on the fact that we hadn't administered the medication correctly!
Admitting mistakes doesn't diminish a veterinarian's knowledge; it strengthens our trust in them. So, for the birds, go elsewhere!
Otherwise, bring cash for payment. No cards!!

Excellent care, staff who go above and beyond professional, passionate and dedicated to the well-being of our pets. Genuine kindness. Flawless expertise with truly educational guidance from the doctor. I recommend the nearby Jouffroy parking lot, run by Eric, who is himself passionate about his canine and feline companions. A wonderful experience.
The nursing and veterinary team are very professional and competent, attentive to our beloved pets. Thank you.
My cat's clinic. I recommend it.

Exceptional! My rabbit is always treated with immense gentleness and care. The staff is very patient and takes the time to explain everything clearly. You can tell they have a genuine passion for animals and want the best for them. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality care and a warm welcome.
Best veterinarian in Paris
Very professional. Our dog was examined very carefully.
Very good clinic
Highly competent and caring veterinarians, quality service and always available for advice, I highly recommend them!
Great clinic! The vet is attentive and asks for updates on the animal by email.

I searched for a competent veterinary clinic for a long time without much success until the day my old cat, Marquis, was taken in by Dr. Elbaz and Dr. Dubreuil. Professionalism, compassion, understanding, support, and above all, a clear explanation of veterinary medicine to ensure maximum comprehension... in short, I have nothing but praise and high praise. I now live in the countryside where routine care is provided by local vets, but in case of any problems, I head straight to the Jouffroy Veterinary Clinic because I have complete confidence in them and I don't hesitate to recommend their contact information to everyone I know.

Thank you to them!
Old Marquis, Marquis Junior, Cyrano, Patouille, Unyx, Vidocq, and finally Nat (not forgetting Goupe!)

A friend recommended Dr. Delval, but I ended up seeing Dr. Dubreuil. I'm so glad I found this vet; he's just fantastic! He took the time to give me tons of advice about the health, hygiene, and training of my first puppy. He seemed passionate about his work and very gentle with animals. The clinic is spotless, and the reception was excellent!

It's hard to find a good veterinary clinic. We tried several in the neighborhood. This one is just the best. Dr. Dubreuil has been taking care of our French bulldog for a year now, and we trust him completely.
